step1_analysis.circuit_type: Delay Cell / Inverter with Explicit Capacitances
step1_analysis.description: The circuit acts as an NMOS inverting switch (XM1) with explicitly added MOS capacitors (XM2, XM3, XM4) to increase the Miller, input, and output capacitances. It is likely used as a discrete-time delay cell in a PLL loop filter to introduce a zero, as described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: A Stabilization Technique for Phase-Locked Frequency Synthesizers

timing_delay.description: Propagation delay of the cell from input Y to output X

sky130_expected.calculation: Total capacitance on node X is C_out ~ 53fF (XM4 + XM2 + XM1 drain). With an external 10k pull-up resistor, the time constant tau = 530ps. Delay ~ 0.69 * tau ~ 360ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the 500ps delay reported in the paper, adjusted for SKY130 parasitic values and an assumed 10k pull-up resistor to make the NMOS switch functional.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the delay cell

sky130_expected.calculation: Static power with 10k pull-up and 50% duty cycle: (1.8^2 / 10k) * 0.5 = 162 uW. Dynamic power at 100MHz: 53fF * 1.8^2 * 100M = 17 uW. Total ~ 180 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 20mW reported in the paper is for the entire synthesizer. A single delay cell consumes much less, dominated by the pull-up resistor static current.

switching_threshold.description: DC input voltage at which the output crosses VDD/2

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS Vth is ~0.42V. The threshold depends on the pull-up resistor and NMOS strength. With W/L=5/0.5 and R=10k, the NMOS is strong, so the threshold is close to Vth, around 0.6V - 0.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard inverter threshold calculation with a resistive load.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise of the synthesizer at 1-MHz offset

sky130_expected.calculation: N/A for a single delay cell.
sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric, cannot be simulated with just the delay cell.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, power consumption, and DC switching threshold of the delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Delay Cell
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 Y X Y GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 X Y GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 GND Y GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND X GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Sources and external components
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Rpullup X VDD 10k
VY Y 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 100p 100p 4.9n 10n)

* Load PDK
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure delays
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(Y) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(X) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(Y) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(X) val=0.9 rise=1
  
  * Measure rise and fall times
  meas tran t_rise trig v(X) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(X) val=1.44 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(X) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(X) val=0.36 fall=1
  
  * Measure power
  let inst_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran avg_power avg inst_power from=0 to=20n
  
  * DC Analysis
  dc VY 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc v_threshold when v(X)=0.9 fall=1
  
  print t_delay_fall t_delay_rise t_rise t_fall avg_power v_threshold
  quit
.endc
